name: web_search
description: Search the web for information. Returns ranked results with titles, URLs, and snippets. Use this first to find relevant pages.

name: fetch_docs
description: Version-accurate library documentation via Context7. USE THIS instead of guessing an API from memory whenever you write code against a third-party library (React, Next.js, Supabase, Tailwind, Prisma, FastAPI, etc). Returns current docs and real code examples with source URLs, pinned to the version you name. Two modes: pass `library` to pull docs on a topic, or omit it to search the index and get candidate library IDs first.

library.description: Library name (e.g. 'next.js', 'supabase') or a full Context7 ID starting with '/' (e.g. '/vercel/next.js'). Omit to just search the index.

topic.description: What you need docs about, e.g. 'middleware auth redirect' or 'useForm defaultValues'. Ranked against the library's docs.

version.description: Pin docs to a version, e.g. 'v7.66.0' or '15'. Appended to the topic query.

tokens.description: Max doc tokens to return (default 5000, max 20000).

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch and extract readable content from specific URLs. Use after web_search to read promising pages.
